verdict.rationale: Trilegal is documented as an India-only firm (offices only in Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai, NCR, Pune, GIFT City, no overseas presence) and its published expertise pages, knowledge repository, and whitepapers cover Indian corporate, PE, IP, employment, and data protection topics, but none reference comparative entity-type or cross-jurisdiction incorporation guidance (Delaware C-corp, UK Ltd, German GmbH/UG) — missing for 10: any comparative jurisdiction-selection content, any Delaware/UK/German incorporation guidance, and any founder-facing entity-choice resource.
